goal: Implement the confirmed native Android frontend interaction contract for the five-page workspace, sessions, chat, weekly components, sources, settings, challenge flow, and resilient local UI states.
acceptance_criteria: Cold start and process-recreated launch enter Home; a live process may restore its prior page after releasing heavy resources.
The circular workspace contains Weekly, Home, Global Graph, static Community, and Global Settings in that order.
Workspace paging, nested horizontal controls, graph canvas mode, challenge threshold/bottom gate, Back stack, and fading spatial indicators do not conflict.
Session cards, preset/custom creation, favorites, drafts, source revisions, and session snapshots obey the confirmed isolation rules.
Chat header, composer, attachments, message actions, rich content, retries, partial generation, and local drafts have complete states.
Weekly components support four fixed sizes, drag/remove/add/source selection, snapping, persistence, and the confirmed Token seven-day view.
Global settings, source management, challenge join/reuse, offline/article states, accessibility, safe areas, and reduced motion are covered.
No export formats, long-term-memory automation, graph algorithm generation, community business actions, or PWA/static-app changes are introduced.
verification_expectations: Run affected native JVM tests and Android lint.
Assemble debug APK only when explicitly requested.
Run emulator/device smoke across narrow and regular widths, light/dark themes, large text, IME, process recreation, and reduced motion.
Record screenshots and interaction evidence for each major route and state.
